author: Dante89
quote:
Please do yourself a favor and save your money. This is not something even Dan Houser would co-sign on. This is not Grand Theft Auto and that Rockstar hates their fans this much is just a new low. 

This is nothing but male shaming, woke and leftist propaganda aimed at the younger gamers. 

On top of all that Rockstar had the nerves to the day before the game released when they knew everyone had pre-downloaded the game and could not get a refund. Then they tell everyone that the game will target 30 fps. Read that again, Target. Which is often even as low as 23 fps. This is absolutely not okay for a over 100$ game. And the game is filled with bugs and glitches and the fact that none of the so called game journalists mention this is pretty obvious. 

The characters are boring and have no personality. The voice acting is a joke compared to other GTA games and Red Dead Redemption 2. 

It is so obvious that the woke activists who calls themselves the devs on Rockstar copy pasted Red Dead Redemption 2's story line and gameplay and somehow made the worst game they could possible make. This is what happens when you take away the talent that made GTA famous in the first place. 

Do yourself a favor and play previous GTA games instead. This is nothing no one should spend their time doing.

author: Dante89
quote:
It's been a long time since a game has lived up to the hype. Nintendo has absolutely nailed this remake!It's so incredibly good that it's worth buying a Nintendo Switch 2 solely for this game. 

The last time I felt this way about a game was when I played Twilight Princess on the Nintendo Wii for the first time. On release-day, I spent 12 hours playing Ocarina of Time, and I have to say, it looks absolutely stunning. The music and sound design are unbelievably good! Use headphones! The gameplay is just as impressive, easily a 10/10. 

I've even tried playing the songs on a regular acoustic guitar, and the game immediately recognizes what you're playing. The same goes for humming or singing: Link recognizes which song you're trying to play. You even get a little lesson in which note you need to sing when you get it wrong because you think you're humming the correct one.

I can HIGHLY recommend The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake! It's a game that truly has soul, humor, drama, action, and adventure. It feels like watching The Lord of the Rings for the very first time. The feeling is absolutely incredible! And it just keeps getting better and **** voice acting sounds like something you'd expect from a multi-billion-dollar movie production. This is the best thing Nintendo has delivered since the Nintendo 64 era... or perhaps ever! I love Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom, but this is something completely different! It's about as close to a perfect game as you can get. By far, it's the greatest remake ever made.

What I want now is for Nintendo to give us updates and DLC for this masterpiece! The Japanese developers must surely realize by now that this was their best project and choice of game. And judging by the reception, I can promise you that we'll be hearing about Majora's Mask before long.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Dante89
quote:
I have been waiting for a South Park game like this since I first started watching the show in 1997. Finally after playing a lot of South Park games to plattforms like dream cast and pc they finally made it right.

South Park: The Stick of Truth has everything a true South Park fan need in a South Park game. Fresh jokes, adventure, action and the freedom to walk around in all of South Park. The best part must definitely be that it looks just like the show and you can't really see any difference from the writing when it comes to the game and the show. I mean there's nothing bad about this game. Well if you wanna be a **** yeah sure it's the stupid censorship on the xbox & ps3 but not on PC which is the most stupid thing I have ever .. ever ! Seen since Capcom fired the creator of Resident Evil. And that they did the censorship here in europe and not in the states is beyond me. I mean I live in Sweden and here they don't even censor swears in tv.

Well enough about that. The game is awesome for anyone who likes South Park and I can say that it was one of the best games I played 2016 !
game_title: South Park: The Stick of Truth
